latest_release.name: Kanboard 1.2.57
latest_release.body:
### Security fixes

* Disable PHP session upload progress in the Docker image to mitigate [CVE-2026-115560](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-23-1).
* Check that the user can access the opposite task's project before adding internal links with bulk changes.
* Hide projects the caller cannot access from the API procedures `getProjectByName`, `getProjectByIdentifier`, and `getProjectByEmail`:
  * They now return `false` instead of a 403 error that revealed the project exists.

### Improvements

* Allow searching users by their exact email address:
  * Emails are matched exactly and case-insensitively, so partial searches cannot be used to discover other users' addresses.

### Bug fixes

* Make text searches case-insensitive for non-ASCII characters with SQLite.
* Fix PHP 8.5 and PHP-FPM configuration issues in the Docker image.
* Remove PHP 8.5 deprecation warnings.

### Dependencies and build

* Remove the unused `composer.json` from the bundled Symfony EventDispatcher, which triggered a false-positive Dependabot alert.
* Update several GitHub Actions.

detail.readme:
Kanboard
========

Kanboard is project management software that focuses on the Kanban methodology.

**This application is in maintenance mode**. What does it mean?

Citing [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maintenance_mode):

> In the world of software development, maintenance mode refers to a point in a computer program's life when it has reached all of its goals and is generally considered to be "complete" and bug-free. The term can also refer to the point in a software product's evolution when it is no longer competitive with other products or current with regard to the technology environment it operates within.

- The [author](#credits) of this application is not actively developing any new major features (only small fixes)
- New releases are published regularly depending on the contributions made by the community
- Pull requests for new features and bug fixes are accepted as long as the [guidelines](.github/pull_request_template.md) are followed
